name: loopboard-todo
description: Renders the workspace TODO.md as an interactive board and spawns coding-agent loop terminals (Claude Code today).

loopBoard.permissionMode.description: --permission-mode passed to the claude CLI when spawning a loop terminal.

loopBoard.defaultWorkerModel.description: The model that owns (works) tasks with no explicit model: field.

loopBoard.defaultGroomerModel.description: The model that grooms tasks/drafts with no explicit groomer: field.

loopBoard.models.opus.enabled.description: Show the Opus slot in the Loops overview and the board's model selects.

loopBoard.models.opus.model.description: Custom --model string spawned for the Opus slot (e.g. opus[1m]). Empty = 'opus'. Invalid strings are ignored.

loopBoard.models.opus.effort.description: Grooming-subagent reasoning-effort ceiling for the Opus slot (Rule 14 in LOOP.md) — the loop chooses low..this ceiling by story complexity, reserving xhigh/max for when the ceiling allows it and the story explicitly asks for deep reasoning.

loopBoard.models.sonnet.model.description: Custom --model string spawned for the Sonnet slot (e.g. sonnet[1m]). Empty = 'sonnet'. Invalid strings are ignored.

loopBoard.models.sonnet.effort.description: Grooming-subagent reasoning-effort ceiling for the Sonnet slot (Rule 14 in LOOP.md) — the loop chooses low..this ceiling by story complexity, reserving xhigh/max for when the ceiling allows it and the story explicitly asks for deep reasoning.

loopBoard.autoRecycle.description: When a model finishes a task, restart its loop terminal (close it and open a new one) so the next task starts fresh. The heavier of the two fresh-context options. Off by default; restart manually with ♻.

loopBoard.clearSessionAfterTask.description: When a model finishes a task, send /clear to its loop terminal so the next task starts fresh. Same result as Auto Recycle but lighter: the terminal keeps running, only the conversation is cleared. Off by default. Ignored when Auto Recycle is on (a restart already clears everything).
